title: Zigzag Rail Component
summary: The zigzag table of contents rail from the docs is now a standalone component that follows nested links and highlights the ones in view.
body:
- [**Zigzag Rail**](/components/zigzag-rail): Added `UiZigZagRail`, the rail used by the docs table of contents. Wrap a list of links with `data-depth` and `data-active` (set for you by `UiScrollspy` in `mode="multiple"`) and the rail draws a line that shifts with the nesting depth and highlights every active section. Supports a dashed track, a custom link selector and RTL.
- [**Scrollspy**](/components/scrollspy): The active section is now recomputed right after the anchors change and after the first layout, so highlights are correct after route changes without waiting for a scroll event.
